messages:
sam (partnerships): Heads-up: Datadog asked to embed a compact telemetry tile in our marketplace tile for an APAC demo next Tue 09:00 SGT. Need eng + obs + SI owners for tech handoff and privacy checks. Who can own this?
keiko (si lead): I can lead SI handoff and airgap plan. Will need a containerized collector image, example forwarding config, and a file-buffer fallback for disconnected installs.
maria (obs PM): Ill own the dashboard import and queries. Please share OTLP exporter config and a tiny sample span to use for widgets. Retention guidance would help for the demo.
jake (eng): I can prototype the embed. Two quick Qs: auth model (signed JWT vs partner token) and CSP/CORS rules for the iframe. Prefer minimizing cross-origin calls.
sam (partnerships): Preference is KMS-signed JWT from our control plane so we can assert trace provenance. @jake can we mint/verify?
datadog-bot: Partner portal reminder: submit MarketplaceTileIntegration form at https://partners.datadog.example/submit and include ingest region.
jake (eng): Yes we can mint JWTs via KMS. Ill sketch a small middleware that validates the JWT, exposes a short session header, and serves a JWK endpoint for verification. ETA ~36h. Will also add permissive CORS for the tile host and tightened CSP around scripts.
keiko (si lead): For airgap installs Ill draft the collector + env var examples and TLS pinning notes. ETA ~48h.
maria (obs PM): Dashboard plan: two tabs (traces, latency heatmap). Sample span for demo: {"trace_id":"t1","span":"infer.req","service":"redwood-inference","latency_ms":10,"attrs":{"model":"redwood-13b","region":"apac-1"}}
sam (partnerships): OK owners and ETAs: Jake (embed + JWT prototype) 36h; Maria (dashboard import + queries) 36h; Keiko (SI collector + airgap doc) 48h. Ill submit the partner form and confirm the demo slot. Weekly sync Thu 09:30 PT. :calendar: :thumbsup:
